channel.title: Best Little Sites - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: STAR WARS: James Mangold's DAWN OF THE JEDI Reportedly DEAD Under New Lucasfilm Leadership
item.description: It seems Logan director James Mangold won't be heading into a Galaxy Far, Far Away after all, as a new rumour claims that his Dawn of the Jedi movie is now "dead" at Lucasfilm.

item.title: SUPERMAN/SPIDER-MAN Variant Covers, Interior Artwork, And Backup Story Details Revealed By Marvel
item.description: Marvel Comics has shared a new look at variant covers for Superman/Spider-Man #1, along with interior artwork and a full breakdown of backup stories featuring Marvel and DC icons.

item.title: BATMAN v SUPERMAN Director Reveals Studio "Pushback" For Casting Jesse Eisenberg As Lex Luthor
item.description: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice director Zack Snyder has revealed that he faced some internal pushback about casting Jesse Eisenberg as Lex Luthor, and explains why he chose the actor.

item.title: Steve Yeun Talks MCU Future After THUNDERBOLTS* Departure; INVINCIBLE Co-Star Pitches DAKOTA NORTH Series
item.description: Invincible stars Steven Yeun and Gillian Jacobs have discussed possibly joining the MCU, and the latter makes a case for why she'd like to bring private eye Dakota North to the screen.

item.title: MONSTERS INC. 3 Officially In Development; COCO 2 & THE INCREDIBLES 3 Set Release Dates
item.description: We have some good news for Monsters, Inc. fans here, as Pixar's Pete Docter has confirmed that a third movie featuring Mike and Sulley is officially in the works...

item.title: Why Is James Gunn Making Right-Wing Extremists The Villains In Nearly Every DCU Movie And TV Show?
item.description: DC Studios has a villain problem, and it boils down to a repetitive overreliance on far-right clichés, an approach that may prove a turn-off in the long-run for those on both sides of the fence.

item.title: DCU Rumor Roundup: Update On James Gunn Potentially Leaving DC Studios; Daniel Craig In THE BATMAN 2, More
item.description: In this DCU rumor roundup, we have updates on some internet scuttkebutt from the past week, including a report that Daniel Craig is being eyed for a role in The Batman - Part II...

item.title: SCARPETTA Interview: Simon Baker And Hunter Parrish On Their Shared Role As Benton Wesley (Exclusive)
item.description: Scarpetta stars Simon Baker and Hunter Parrish break down their approach to playing the present-day and past versions of FBI profiler Benton Wesley in the new Prime Video series.
